name: 73109 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73109 (Oklahoma City) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73109 (Oklahoma City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 73109 (Oklahoma City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
